description: Make an independent copy of a remote artifact, for example 'use this report as a template' or 'create my own version'. Returns a new artifact identifier and address; the source is unchanged. Requires permission to copy its contents. Use update/edit when the user wants changes at the existing address instead.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

slug.description: Artifact identifier returned by find/publish, or the slug in its /s/ URL. Not a local path.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.

name: artifact_site_fork
title: Fork a site
